import * as Query from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { loadEditorRegions as loadOptions } from '../adapters/editorRegionsAdapter.js';
export const RegionField = () => {
  const options = Query.useQuery({ queryKey: ['regions'], queryFn: loadOptions });
  return <select>{options.data?.map((region) => <option>{region.name}</option>)}</select>;
};
